expected_bytes: LOCAL-ONLY pe-targets.json; compare code sites before arming
correlation: Same thread and call instance using entry RSP/return site; tail jump is not an independent caller. Reject ambiguous recursion and unrelated hits.
reads: Registers, validated 8-byte operand/global/return-slot reads only; no bulk dump or guessed type walk.
flush: Flush each record before resume; final marker lists observed, missing and failed records. Truncated JSON/absent terminal marker means incomplete.
breakpoint_design: Hardware execution breakpoints proposed; debug-register and debugger resume-context changes require explicit review. No software INT3 patch by default.
return_capture: Same A2R thread; selected R8; return inside observer DLL; entry RSP at tail and RSP+8 at return
watchdog: Independent WaitForDebugEventEx 50 ms loop; 5 s setup and 5 s armed; OS/cleanup latency may overshoot
cleanup: Restore original selected-thread debug registers using suspend/resume then detach with kill-on-exit disabled; failures require operator recovery; no forced termination
